findings_to_judge.finding: BLS PPI for 'Plastics Sewer, Stormdrain and Water Main Pipe' (WPU072106038) — CNM's single largest product exposure — averaged 185.2 across May/Jun/Jul 2026 (CNM's fiscal Q2, 4 May-2 Aug) versus 186.5 a year earlier, i.e. -0.7% y/y, against -8.2% y/y in CNM's fiscal Q1 (Feb-Apr 2026: 174.95 vs 190.48); the July 2026 reading of 188.565 is actually +1.9% ABOVE July 2025 and +8.2% above the March 2026 trough, so the deflation that drove the Sept-2025 guidance cut had fully reversed by the last month of this quarter.

findings_to_judge.finding: Mueller Water Products — the largest US maker of fire hydrants and iron gate valves, sold almost entirely through waterworks distributors of which CNM is the biggest — reported its quarter ended 30 June 2026 (two of CNM's three Q2 months) on 5 August with net sales +4.1% to $395.9M driven 'primarily by higher pricing across most product lines' partially offset by slightly lower volumes, record adjusted EBITDA +24.3%, adjusted EPS +47.1%, and a third consecutive raise to FY26 adjusted EBITDA guidance (to $367-372M).

US single-family housing starts fell 9.9% m/m in July 2026 to an 808k SAAR, the lowest since November 2022 — a deterioration inside the final month of CNM's quarter and after management said on 10 June that residential lot development had 'largely stabilized' with 'no further deterioration'.

CNM raised $750M of 6.000% senior notes due 2034 on 1 July 2026 — inside fiscal Q2 — with proceeds earmarked for prepaying the 2028 term loan and for 'general corporate purposes, including... mergers and acquisitions, share repurchases', at the same time as it had $581M left on the $1bn authorisation, had just run its highest-ever quarterly buyback ($88M / 1.8M shares in Q1 plus $37M / 0.8M shares in the five weeks to 10 June), and management flagged 'a pretty notable uptick in the pipeline... to larger opportunities' and said it might 'overperform some of our M&A goals'.
